name: MERN Stack Development (MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js)

beginner.summary: For freshers and developers who want to build complete JavaScript applications on MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js. Covers the MERN environment, modern JavaScript, a MERN project layout, an Express server, MongoDB data design, Mongoose models, CRUD endpoints, API tests, a React client with Vite, state and effects, routing, forms, calling the API, JWT login, protected routes, image uploads, search and pagination, end-to-end error handling and deployment.
prerequisites: Has written small programs with functions, arrays and objects
Comfortable with a terminal and Git
outcomes: Build a complete MERN application from database to user interface
Design MongoDB data and Express APIs for a React client
Add login, uploads, search and error handling
Deploy a MERN application to the cloud

days.topic: MERN Stack Overview and Development Environment Setup
subtopics: What each part of MERN does
How a request flows from React to MongoDB and back
MERN compared with MEAN and other stacks
Installing Node.js with a version manager
Creating a MongoDB Atlas free cluster
VS Code extensions for MERN work
Postman or Bruno for API calls
days.lab_task: Install the toolchain, create an Atlas cluster with a database user and IP access list, connect with Compass, create a Git repository and sketch the job board project you will build.
days.deliverable: Working toolchain, Atlas cluster and project sketch
checks: node and npm report their versions
Pages, data and API calls listed for the job board
objectives: Explain how MERN parts fit together

days.topic: Modern JavaScript for MERN Developers
subtopics: Error handling with try and catch
days.lab_task: Solve ten small data tasks on a jobs JSON file with modern JavaScript, load the file asynchronously and handle a broken file with try and catch.
checks: All ten outputs match the expected results
Clear error instead of a crash
objectives: Use modern JavaScript in MERN code

days.topic: Project Structure for a MERN Monorepo
subtopics: Folder structure for routes, models and controllers
Linting and formatting across the repo
days.lab_task: Create a monorepo with client and server workspaces, run both with one command, share lint and format rules and write a README that gets a new developer running in five minutes.
checks: One command starts client and server
One lint command checks both workspaces
Peer runs the project from the README alone

days.topic: Express Server: Routes, Controllers and Middleware
days.lab_task: Build the job board server with routers for jobs and companies, controllers, CORS for the client origin, logging, 404 handling and a central error handler.
checks: Only the client origin allowed by CORS

days.topic: Designing MERN Data in MongoDB: Collections and Documents
subtopics: Designing for the screens you build
days.lab_task: Design the job board collections from the screens in your sketch, choose embedding or references for each relation, load sample data with a mongosh script and add indexes for search fields.
days.deliverable: Data design document and seed script
checks: Each embed or reference choice explained
objectives: Design MongoDB data for an app

days.topic: Mongoose Models, Validation and Relationships
days.lab_task: Create Mongoose models for jobs, companies and users with validation, timestamps and references, populate the company on job queries and return clear validation errors.
checks: Validation error lists the bad fields

days.topic: CRUD REST Endpoints for the App
subtopics: Create, read, update and delete handlers
days.lab_task: Build full CRUD endpoints for jobs and companies with filtering by location and type, PATCH updates, invalid ID handling and consistent JSON responses.
checks: Every CRUD request succeeds with the right status
400 returned instead of a server error

days.topic: Testing the API with Postman and Jest
subtopics: Running collections from the command line
Jest and Supertest for API tests
Seeding and clearing data between tests
days.lab_task: Add Postman tests to the collection and run them with Newman, write Jest and Supertest tests against an in-memory MongoDB and block commits that fail the tests.
days.deliverable: API test suites and pre-commit hook
checks: All Postman tests pass from the command line
API tests pass against the in-memory database
objectives: Test APIs with Postman and Jest

days.topic: Building the React Client with Vite
subtopics: Styling with CSS modules or Tailwind
Reusable job card and list components
days.lab_task: Build the job board pages from the sketch with layout, job card, job list and company components, styled and responsive, using sample data before the API is connected.
checks: Home, list and detail pages render from sample data
Layout works on mobile and desktop
Component tree visible in React DevTools

days.topic: React State and Effects for API Data
subtopics: Derived values instead of extra state
days.lab_task: Load jobs from the Express API with a custom hook, show loading, error and empty states, filter jobs on the client with derived values and avoid duplicate requests in development.
checks: Jobs from MongoDB appear in the list

days.topic: React Router for MERN Pages
subtopics: Routes for list, detail and forms
days.lab_task: Add routes for home, jobs, job detail, post a job and account pages, keep filters in the URL, show a not-found page and lazy-load the account area.
checks: Detail page loads from the URL parameter

days.topic: Forms and Client-Side Validation in React
days.lab_task: Build the post a job form with React Hook Form and Zod, show field errors, map server validation errors from Express to fields and make the form accessible.
checks: Field errors shown before any request
Server field errors shown on the right inputs
Form fully usable without a mouse

days.topic: Calling the Express API from React
subtopics: Sending JSON with fetch or axios
Handling HTTP errors in one place
Sharing types or schemas between client and server
days.lab_task: Write an API client module used by every page, proxy API calls in development, handle errors centrally, refresh lists after creating or deleting jobs and share Zod schemas with the server.
checks: New job appears in the list without a reload
Client calls the API without CORS errors in development
Client and server validate with the same schema

days.topic: User Registration and Login with JWT
subtopics: User model and password hashing with bcrypt
Login and signup pages in React
days.lab_task: Add registration and login with hashed passwords and JWTs, build signup and login pages, send the token with API calls and show the logged-in user in the header.
checks: Password stored as a hash in MongoDB
Token issued and user shown in the header
Log in with a wrong password

days.topic: Protected Routes on Client and Server
subtopics: Roles: job seeker, employer and admin
Hiding actions the user cannot take
days.lab_task: Protect job creation and editing on the server, allow employers to edit only their own jobs, guard React routes, redirect to login and back, and test the rules.
checks: Open a protected page signed out
Redirected to login and returned after sign-in
User asked to log in again

days.topic: Image Uploads with Multer and Cloud Storage
subtopics: File uploads in Express with Multer
days.lab_task: Add company logo uploads with Multer, validate type and size, store images in cloud storage, save URLs in MongoDB, show previews and progress in React and delete replaced logos.
checks: Logo stored in the cloud and shown on job cards

days.topic: Pagination, Search and Sorting Across the Stack
days.lab_task: Add search by keyword, filters, sorting and paginated results to the jobs API, build matching controls in React with URL state and debounce the search box.
checks: Pages contain no duplicates or gaps

days.topic: Error Handling and Notifications End to End
subtopics: Error types: validation, auth, not found and server
days.lab_task: Standardise error responses on the server, show toasts for success and failure, add an error boundary to the client, retry network failures and send errors to Sentry.
checks: Error boundary shows a fallback page
Errors from client and server appear in Sentry

days.topic: Deploying a MERN App: Atlas, Render and Vercel
subtopics: Deploying the Express API to Render or Railway
Deploying the React client to Vercel or Netlify
days.lab_task: Deploy the API to Render and the client to Vercel, connect them to Atlas with production settings, set CORS for the live domain and redeploy automatically from Git.
checks: Client loads data from the live API
Only the live client domain allowed

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: MERN Job Board
days.lab_task: Complete the job board with employer and job seeker accounts, job posting with logos, search and pagination, applications, error handling, tests and a live deployment, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, live URL and demo recording
checks: Posting, searching and applying work end to end
Live site works on mobile and desktop
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one product

intermediate.summary: For developers who have built a MERN application. Covers TypeScript and Zod across a MERN codebase, Redux Toolkit and RTK Query, advanced Mongoose, refresh tokens and cookie sessions, role-based access, real-time chat with Socket.IO, queued emails and notifications, Stripe payments, media at scale, moving the front end to Next.js, API and UI testing, performance, security hardening, Docker Compose, CI/CD, monitoring, AWS hosting and team workflow.
prerequisites: Has built and deployed a MERN application
Comfortable with React hooks, Express routes and Mongoose models
outcomes: Build typed, secure and tested MERN applications
Add real-time, payments, media and background work
Containerise, deploy and monitor MERN apps
Work effectively in a MERN team

days.topic: Typing a MERN App End to End with TypeScript and Zod
subtopics: Zod schemas as the single source of types
Migrating a JavaScript MERN app gradually
days.lab_task: Convert the job board to TypeScript in strict mode, create a shared package of Zod schemas and inferred types, and use it in Mongoose models, Express handlers and the React client.
checks: No type errors in strict mode
Type errors appear in client and server where needed
Invalid requests rejected by the shared schema

days.topic: Global State with Redux Toolkit and RTK Query
subtopics: When a MERN app needs global state
Alternatives such as Zustand and TanStack Query
days.lab_task: Move API calls to RTK Query with cache tags, keep auth state in a slice, add optimistic saved jobs with rollback and inspect actions in Redux DevTools.
days.deliverable: Client using Redux Toolkit and RTK Query
objectives: Manage client state with Redux Toolkit
Cache server data with RTK Query

days.topic: Advanced Mongoose: Aggregation, Population and Indexes for App Queries
days.lab_task: Build employer dashboards with aggregation pipelines, replace deep population with targeted queries, add compound indexes from explain plans and implement soft deletes.
checks: Applications per job per week returned correctly
Job hidden from lists but kept in the database

days.topic: Refresh Tokens, HTTP-Only Cookies and Session Security
days.lab_task: Replace stored tokens with short-lived access tokens and rotated refresh tokens in HTTP-only cookies, add CSRF protection, session revocation and logout from all devices.
checks: Refresh cookie is HTTP-only, secure and SameSite

days.topic: Role-Based Access Control in MERN Apps
days.lab_task: Add a permission model for seekers, employers, recruiters and admins, enforce it in middleware and ownership checks, build an admin panel and log sensitive actions.
days.deliverable: RBAC model, admin panel and tests
checks: Every role and action combination tested
Sensitive actions recorded with user and time

days.topic: Real-Time Chat with Socket.IO
days.lab_task: Add chat between employers and candidates with Socket.IO rooms, saved message history, typing indicators, read receipts and reconnection, then scale to two server instances.
checks: Message appears instantly for the other user

days.topic: Notifications and Emails with Queues
subtopics: Why emails should not block requests
Job queues with BullMQ and Redis
days.lab_task: Send application emails through a BullMQ queue with templates and retries, add in-app notifications with read state, user preferences and a daily digest job.
checks: Employer receives an email without slowing the request
Job retries and records the failure
Users who opt out receive no emails

days.topic: Payments with Stripe in a MERN App
subtopics: Stripe Checkout for one-off and recurring payments
Featured job listings as a paid product
days.lab_task: Sell featured job listings with Stripe Checkout, confirm payments through webhooks, store payment state in MongoDB, process a refund and test with the Stripe CLI.
checks: Job becomes featured after webhook confirmation

days.topic: File and Media Handling at Scale with S3 and a CDN
days.lab_task: Move uploads to direct S3 uploads, store resumes privately with signed download links, resize images in a background job, scan files and serve public images through CloudFront.
checks: File goes straight to S3 and is private
Signed link works for the employer and expires

days.topic: Moving a MERN Front End to Next.js
subtopics: Why teams move from a Vite client to Next.js
Server components that call the API
days.lab_task: Move the public job pages to Next.js with server rendering while keeping Express as the API, share login between the two and measure SEO and load-time gains.
days.deliverable: Partially migrated front end with measurements
checks: Render job pages on the server
Job content present in page source
Signed-in state works across both apps
Lighthouse SEO and performance scores compared

days.topic: API Testing with Supertest and MongoDB Memory Server
days.lab_task: Build a full API test suite with data factories, permission tests, mocked Stripe and S3, and contract tests that fail when the API breaks the client.
days.deliverable: API test suite with coverage report
checks: All tests pass in under two minutes
Contract test fails on a response change
Coverage of 80 percent or more on controllers and services

days.topic: React Testing Library and Playwright for MERN
subtopics: Testing components the way users use them
Mocking the API with Mock Service Worker
days.lab_task: Test the job form, job list and protected routes with React Testing Library and Mock Service Worker, and write Playwright tests for sign-up, posting and applying.
checks: Sign-up, post and apply flows pass
UI tests run without the server

days.topic: Performance: Lean Queries, Redis Caching and React Memoisation
days.lab_task: Load test the jobs endpoint, add projections, lean queries and Redis caching, cut unnecessary React re-renders found with the Profiler and split the client bundle.
days.deliverable: Performance report with before and after results
checks: Re-renders reduced on the job list

days.topic: Security Hardening: Helmet, Rate Limits, Sanitisation and CORS
subtopics: XSS in React and dangerous HTML
days.lab_task: Find and fix planted issues: a NoSQL injection in login, missing rate limits, an XSS through rich text and an over-permissive CORS policy, then scan the app with ZAP.
checks: Operator injection in login no longer works
Script in rich text is not executed

days.topic: Dockerising the MERN Stack with Docker Compose
subtopics: Dockerfiles for the API and client
Docker Compose with MongoDB and Redis
days.lab_task: Containerise the API and client, run the full stack with MongoDB and Redis in Docker Compose with health checks and volumes, and add a development setup with live reload.
checks: All services healthy with one command

days.topic: CI/CD with GitHub Actions for MERN
subtopics: Workflow for lint, type check and tests
Services in CI: MongoDB and Redis
days.lab_task: Build a GitHub Actions pipeline that tests the API with a MongoDB service, tests the client, builds images, deploys previews for pull requests and deploys to production after approval.
checks: Tests and preview deploy run automatically
Previous version restored from the pipeline

days.topic: Logging and Monitoring a MERN App
subtopics: Request IDs across client and server
days.lab_task: Add structured logs with request IDs, API metrics, Atlas alerts, front-end monitoring and uptime checks, build one dashboard and respond to a simulated outage.
checks: Same request ID in client and server logs
Outage detected and resolved with notes

days.topic: Hosting MERN on AWS
subtopics: Hosting options: EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, ECS and App Runner
Hosting the React client on S3 and CloudFront
Connecting to Atlas from AWS with private networking
days.lab_task: Host the client on S3 with CloudFront and the API on App Runner or ECS behind HTTPS, connect privately to Atlas, store secrets in Secrets Manager and compare monthly costs.
checks: Client and API work over HTTPS
API reaches Atlas over private networking
Monthly cost estimated for two hosting options

days.topic: Code Reviews and Git Workflow in MERN Teams
subtopics: Review checklists for API and UI changes
days.lab_task: Work in pairs on two features with feature branches, small pull requests, review checklists and conventional commits, resolve a planted merge conflict and agree a definition of done.
days.deliverable: Team workflow guide and reviewed pull requests
checks: Review uses the checklist with specific comments
Definition of done adopted by the team

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Real-Time Project Management App
days.lab_task: Build a project management app with teams, roles, real-time boards, chat, notifications, file attachments, payments for paid plans, tests, monitoring and a CI/CD pipeline, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, live URL, test reports and presentation
checks: Boards update live for two users
Security, performance and test reports meet targets
State, data and hosting choices explained
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one product

advanced.summary: For senior MERN engineers and leads building high-traffic products. Covers MERN architecture for scale, MongoDB design for heavy traffic, event-driven MERN with change streams and queues, multi-tenant SaaS, horizontal scaling, caching architecture, a GraphQL layer, React client architecture, threat modelling, OpenTelemetry tracing, Kubernetes, serverless options, Atlas Search and Vector Search, cross-tier performance, zero-downtime migrations, quality gates, cost optimisation, cross-tier troubleshooting and technical leadership.
prerequisites: Several years building production MERN applications
Strong TypeScript, MongoDB and React experience
Has deployed and operated apps in the cloud
outcomes: Architect MERN systems for high traffic and many tenants
Scale, secure and observe every tier
Run zero-downtime changes and control cost
Lead MERN teams and technical decisions

days.topic: MERN Architecture for Scale: Modular Services and Boundaries
subtopics: From a single Express app to modules
Domain boundaries in a MERN product
API gateway and BFF for the React client
days.lab_task: Restructure a large MERN app into modules with clear boundaries and data ownership, extract one module as a service behind a BFF and record the decisions.
checks: Lint fails on a cross-module import
Extracted service works behind the BFF
Each decision lists options and consequences

days.topic: MongoDB Data Design for High-Traffic MERN Apps
subtopics: Schema patterns: bucket, computed, subset and outlier
Read and write concerns for app features
days.lab_task: Redesign the data model of a high-traffic feed and messaging feature using schema patterns, choose a shard key, plan archiving and migrate documents between schema versions.
days.deliverable: Data model redesign with load test results
checks: Feed reads use one query per page
Load spread evenly across shards in testing
Old and new documents both read correctly

days.topic: Event-Driven MERN with Change Streams and Message Queues
subtopics: Change streams for reacting to data
The outbox pattern with MongoDB transactions
days.lab_task: Publish domain events through an outbox, consume them idempotently to update search and analytics, push live updates to React from change streams and resume after a restart.
checks: Consumer resumes from the token without missing events
React client updates from change events

days.topic: Multi-Tenant MERN SaaS Design
days.lab_task: Make a MERN product multi-tenant with tenant context, tenant-scoped queries enforced in one place, per-tenant branding and limits, and tests that prove isolation.
checks: No cross-tenant data in any endpoint

days.topic: Scaling Express and Node.js Horizontally
tools: NGINX or a cloud load balancer
days.lab_task: Scale the API to six instances behind a load balancer with shared sessions, socket scaling, distributed rate limits and tuned Atlas pools, and find the new capacity limit.
checks: No Atlas connection errors at peak

days.topic: Caching Architecture with Redis and CDNs
subtopics: Layers: browser, CDN, API and database
days.lab_task: Design caching for a high-traffic job search across CDN, API and Redis layers, implement invalidation from events and measure hit rates, freshness and origin load.
checks: Origin requests reduced at the same traffic
Updated jobs visible within the agreed time
One rebuild per expired key under load

days.topic: GraphQL Layer for MERN Apps
subtopics: When GraphQL helps a MERN product
Schema design for the React client
days.lab_task: Add a GraphQL layer for the dashboard over existing services, batch MongoDB access with DataLoader, use Apollo Client in React and enforce authorisation and cost limits.
checks: Nested dashboard query runs a small fixed number of database queries
Dashboard renders from the cached graph

days.topic: React Client Architecture for Large MERN Products
subtopics: State architecture: server, client and URL state
days.lab_task: Restructure a large React client by feature, separate server, client and URL state, publish a shared component library in Storybook and set performance budgets per feature.
days.deliverable: Client architecture guide and component library
checks: Each feature loads its own code
Build fails when a feature exceeds its budget

days.topic: Threat Modelling and Security Architecture for MERN
subtopics: Authentication architecture with an identity provider
Securing MongoDB Atlas: network, users and auditing
days.lab_task: Threat model the product, move login to an identity provider, encrypt sensitive candidate fields, lock down Atlas network access and auditing, and close findings from a test.
days.deliverable: Threat model, security changes and test report
checks: Threats mapped to every component and data flow
Sensitive fields unreadable in the database

days.topic: OpenTelemetry Tracing Across the MERN Stack
subtopics: Tracing from the browser to the database
days.lab_task: Trace a job application from the React click through Express, MongoDB and the email queue, set sampling, define an SLO for applying and alert on error budget burn.
checks: One trace covers browser, API, database and queue
SLO and error budget agreed for applying
Alert fires during a simulated failure

days.topic: Kubernetes Deployment for MERN Services
subtopics: Deploying API and client containers to Kubernetes
days.lab_task: Package the MERN app as a Helm chart, deploy to Kubernetes with probes, TLS ingress and autoscaling, connect to Atlas and prove a rollout drops no requests.
checks: No failed requests during the rollout
Ingress serves the app with a valid certificate

days.topic: Serverless MERN with AWS Lambda and Vercel Functions
subtopics: Connection reuse to Atlas from functions
days.lab_task: Move the reporting and webhook parts of the API to serverless functions, reuse Atlas connections, measure cold starts and compare cost with containers at three traffic levels.
checks: Connection count stays stable under load
Cold start times recorded and reduced
Monthly cost compared at three traffic levels

days.topic: Search and AI Features with Atlas Search and Vector Search
subtopics: Matching candidates to jobs with embeddings
days.lab_task: Replace text search with Atlas Search autocomplete and facets, add semantic job matching with Vector Search and hybrid ranking, and measure relevance on a labelled query set.
checks: Relevant jobs found without shared keywords
Relevance scores improve on the labelled set

days.topic: Performance Engineering Across MongoDB, Node.js and React
subtopics: Node.js event loop and CPU profiling
days.lab_task: Find and fix the main bottleneck in each tier for a slow dashboard journey, set a budget for the journey and add a regression check to CI.
days.deliverable: Cross-tier performance report and CI check
checks: Slow queries removed from the profiler
Render time for the dashboard reduced
CI fails when the journey budget is exceeded

days.topic: Data Migrations and Zero-Downtime Releases
days.lab_task: Rename and restructure a heavily used field with expand and contract, backfill in batches, release behind a flag with a canary and roll back once to prove the plan.
days.deliverable: Migration plan, scripts and release record
checks: Canary users get the new version first
Rollback restores the old behaviour without data loss

days.topic: Testing Strategy and Quality Gates for MERN Teams
subtopics: Contract testing between client and API
days.lab_task: Assess the test suite of a large MERN product, add contract tests and mutation testing, set quality gates in CI and add synthetic checks for the top journeys.
checks: API change breaks the contract test
Mutation score measured for core modules
Synthetic check alerts on a broken journey

days.topic: Cost Optimisation for MERN Hosting
subtopics: Cost drivers across Atlas, compute, storage and CDN
Cost per tenant and per feature
days.lab_task: Analyse a month of MERN hosting costs, right-size Atlas and compute, cut transfer and storage costs, report cost per tenant and set budget alerts.
checks: Top cost drivers identified with amounts
Monthly cost reduced with no SLO breach

days.topic: Production Incidents in MERN Apps: Troubleshooting Across Tiers
subtopics: Triage from alerts and user reports
Slow pages caused by the database
Collecting evidence without making things worse
days.lab_task: Work through four incidents: a missing index after a release, a Node.js memory leak, a socket reconnect storm and a client crash, restore service and write one post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Incident notes and a post-incident review
checks: All four incidents mitigated within their time limits
Review lists causes and follow-up actions

days.topic: Technical Leadership for MERN Product Teams
subtopics: Estimating and planning with product managers
days.lab_task: Run an architecture review of a MERN product, create a project template with standards built in, write a technical debt plan and present a quarterly engineering plan.
days.deliverable: Review report, template and engineering plan
checks: New app from the template passes all checks

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Scalable MERN Marketplace
days.lab_task: Design and build a multi-tenant marketplace with event-driven features, caching layers, Atlas Search, zero-downtime migrations, tracing and SLOs, cost controls and a security review, then defend it to a review panel.
days.deliverable: Platform repository, architecture document and defence
checks: Load test meets the agreed SLOs
Review panel questions answered with evidence
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one product
